Procurement Officer Job at Med-In Pharmaceutical Limited




        
    

        
        Med-In Pharmaceutical Limited, a producer, manufacturer and seller of intravenous infusion, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Procurement Officer

Job Location: Sagamu Interchange, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
Sourcing and Supplier Management:
     

            
    




	Identify and evaluate potential suppliers for pharmaceuticals, raw materials, and services.
	Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery.
	Conduct market research to identify new sourcing opportunities.
	Procure materials from the local and international markets as forwarded by different departments


Negotiation and Contract Management:


	Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers while ensuring compliance with company policies and regulations.
	Draft, review, and manage contracts and purchase orders to ensure they meet company standards and legal requirements.


Inventory Management:


	Monitor inventory levels and forecasts to ensure adequate supply without overstocking.
	Collaborate with different departments to streamline inventory practices and reduce waste.


Regulatory Compliance:


	Ensure all purchasing practices and supplier relationships comply with relevant pharmaceutical regulations and industry standards
	Maintain documentation related to procurement activities, contracts, and supplier evaluations.


Cost Control and Budgeting:


	Assist in budgeting processes by providing insights on procurement costs and identifying potential savings.
	Analyze spending data and trends to develop cost-saving initiatives.


Cross-Functional Collaboration:


	Work closely with quality assurance, and manufacturing teams to understand their procurement needs and ensure timely delivery of materials.
	Support the development of product specifications in collaboration with relevant departments.


Performance Monitoring


	Assess supplier performance regularly using key performance indicators (KPIs).
	Implement corrective actions based on performance evaluations and feedback.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Bid Manager Job at Western Development Company Limited




        
    

        
        Western Development Company Limited (WDCL) is an independent limited liability company, established in Nigeria for over 13 years ago. WDCL is the sole representative of various overseas companies in the fields of Information Technology, Telecommunications, Mechanical Engineering and Electrical/Electronic Engineering.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Bid Manager

Job Location: Ilesa, Osun
Industry: Oil & Gas Servicing
Reporting To: GM – Technical

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Bid Manager to lead and manage our end-to-end bidding process within the Oil & Gas servicing sector.
	The ideal candidate will have strong experience in managing technical and commercial bids, coordinating multidisciplinary bidding teams, engaging technical partners, and ensuring timely and compliant submissions that position the company competitively for business opportunities


Key Responsibilities


	Manage the end-to-end bid process, from opportunity identification through submission and post-bid review.
	Coordinate the bidding team to ensure effective, efficient, and timely delivery of high-quality bids.
	Identify and engage suitable technical partners where required to strengthen bids or bridge technical, facility, or capability gaps.
	Ensure timely submission of compliant technical and commercial bids in line with client requirements.
	Review client tender documents and ensure all technical, commercial, and compliance requirements are fully addressed.
	Prepare, review, and coordinate technical bid submissions to ensure accuracy and compliance with specifications.
	Prepare and review the commercial aspects of bids, working closely with relevant internal teams.
	Coordinate and plan client presentations required as part of the bid process.
	Lead post-bid reviews and drive continuous improvement in the organisation’s bidding processes and strategies.
	Coordinate and ensure successful client site/facility visits, including all necessary preparations and logistics.
	Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders, clients, and technical partners throughout the bid process.
	Provide regular bid status and performance reports to the GM – Technical.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Physical Sciences, or a related discipline (B.Eng, B.Tech, B.Sc).
	Minimum of 7 years of elevant experience in bid/tender management, preferably within the Oil & Gas industry.
	Proven experience managing both technical and commercial aspects of Oil & Gas bids/tenders.
	Experience working with Oil & Gas operators, service companies, EPC contractors, or related industry stakeholders will be an advantage.


Required Skills & Competencies:


	Excellent time management, organisation, and attention to detail
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
	Ability to work independently and collaboratively under pressure
	Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and coordination skills
	Strategic and creative approach to bid development
	Ability to interpret tender requirements and manage multiple bids within tight detailed.

title: Job Openings at Max Drive
content:
Max Drive - We are a team of passionate people and a leading technology-enabled company driven by a vision to solve the mobility challenges in Africa. We want to get people and goods to their destinations hitch-free. It is personal for us because we understand the frustration of epileptic transportation. We are making mobility safe, affordable, accessible, and sustainable through the deployment of high-performance technologies and operators.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Internal Control & Compliance Manager

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo

Role Overview
     

            
    




	Responsible for the review, implementation and application of control to systems, Internal Policies, Processes & Procedures, Audit and Risk Strategic Plan within MAX’s environment, in order to ensure that risk management and loss containment measures are adhered to in line with the organization’s strategy.


Key Responsibilities


	Review and authenticate monthly bank reconciliation statement prepared by finance unit for their country
	Formulate policies and procedures to improve internal controls, compliance and efficiency. 
	Deliver
	 adequate and timely reporting on the internal control framework and control deficiencies to ensure appropriate communication, documentation, escalation to business partners, senior leadership and the audit committee
	Review cash advances and floats
	Lead the process for internal controls reviews across the team
	Reconciliation of internal accounts
	Deliver adequate and timely action plans and monitor progress to address and resolve control deficiencies
	Review of documentation on PAMS
	Review of contract documentation on LAMs
	Reconciliation of Inventory stock at all locations
	Leadership & Team Building
	Build a strong team and delegate effectively
	Motivate, develop and inspire an enthusiastic team to achieve remarkable results.
	Coach team members to deliver exceptional results.


Requirements


	Minimum of a relevant Bachelor’s Degree in Accounts or Finance
	Minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience in Audit and Control
	Professional Qualification is an added advantage
	Experience in driving the risk management function
	Proven experience of developing controls to block leakages within organisational set-up.
	Knowledge of and experience in Risk and Compliance
	Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group including executives, managers, and subject matter experts
	Assertive, methodical and analytical with good listening skills and a strong customer focus
	Demonstrates commitment through action and can build and develop trust
	Understanding and experience of strategic business management would be beneficial.


Click here to apply online

 

2.) Fleet Operations Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Role Overview


	The Fleet Operations is expected to maximize vehicle uptime, maintain flawless digital records in the proprietary Computerized Maintenance Management System (VAMS), streamline the lifecycle from procurement to refurbishment, and foster strong cross-functional collaboration to hit operational targets.


Key Responsibilities
Documentation:
